message: The invoice total vat amount in vat accounting currency (BT-111) at {@/BT-111} is {/BT-111}, which needs more fraction digits than this edition admits: as many fraction digits as the minor unit of the VAT accounting currency (BT-6).
note: The identifier of this family is not the standard's: clause 6.5.13 states the allowed number of fraction digits per business term in a table and gives no rule identifier, and the validation artefacts of the 2017 edition number one rule per row. A term that has a row in both editions keeps the number those artefacts gave it so that two reports can be compared; a row this edition adds is numbered from 30 upwards, which no release of the artefacts used. The amount is written in the VAT accounting currency (BT-6), so the minor unit is that currency's; where the invoice names none, there is nothing to count against. An invoice that states BT-111 and names no BT-6 is therefore bounded by no rule of this edition: BR-53 asks for the total where the currency is named, and no rule asks for the currency where the total is stated.
